prompt: Can we start the billing migration Monday? What's the rollback, and who owns it?

sources.title: Billing provider migration approved
quotes: Rollback plan: feature flag toggles back to the legacy provider per tenant.

sources.title: Runbook: Billing provider migration
quotes: mirror invoices to the new provider (write-only; no customer impact)
the flag can flip any tenant back to legacy within five minutes

sources.title: Q3 Planning
quotes: Billing provider migration parallel-run starts Monday. Sarah owns it.

answer.text: The billing provider migration's parallel run is scheduled to start Monday
and it is write-only, with no customer impact
. Rollback is a feature flag that toggles a tenant back to the legacy provider
, and the runbook says it can flip any tenant back within five minutes
